m9IF9Lp8K8FKKy-8jY_ONg.zh: 聖露西亞報告自2021年以來首例確診病例,該患者住院4天並接受支持性照護後,已完全康復,目前國內尚未發現其他病例。美洲包括古巴、法屬圭亞那、蓋亞那及蘇利南等地疫情持續,不同地區間人口流動且當地存在病媒蚊,造成該國仍有病例發生風險。
m9IF9Lp8K8FKKy-8jY_ONg.en: Saint Lucia has reported its first confirmed case since 2021. The patient was hospitalized for 4 days, received supportive care and has fully recovered; no other cases have been found in the country so far. Outbreaks continue in the Americas, including Cuba, French Guiana, Guyana and Suriname. Population movement between different areas, together with the presence of vector mosquitoes, means the country still faces a risk of cases.

1RpUyy5NiNuqOnzMR8MVaA.zh: 蘇利南疫情更新,於去年底報告自2016年以來首例本土病例,迄今年1月底累計712例疑病例(327例確診)及1例死亡,以北部巴拉馬利波區之確診病例數為多。 玻利維亞發生疫情,該國今年1-5週累計報告1,534例病例,其中以東部聖克魯斯省1,409例最多,該省近1週另新增1,515例病例,截至2月中已累計報告3,004例。該國去年累計報告近7,000例病例及4例死亡,美國CDC近期提升該國疫情旅遊警示至第2級。 古巴疫情持續,今年1月累計報告1,457例病例(114例確診)及2例死亡,去年累計報告51,217例病例(近2,000例確診)及46例死亡。
1RpUyy5NiNuqOnzMR8MVaA.en: Suriname's epidemic update: at the end of last year, the first locally acquired case since 2016 was reported. As of the end of January this year, 712 suspected cases (327 confirmed) and 1 death have been reported cumulatively, with the most confirmed cases in Paramaribo District in the north. Bolivia's outbreak continues: in weeks 1–5 this year, 1,534 cases were reported cumulatively, of which 1,409 were in the eastern Santa Cruz Department, the most of any area. In the past week, that department added a further 1,515 cases, and 3,004 cases had been reported cumulatively by mid-February. Last year Bolivia reported nearly 7,000 cases and 4 deaths, and the US CDC recently raised its travel notice for the country to Level 2. Cuba's outbreak continues: 1,457 cases (114 confirmed) and 2 deaths were reported cumulatively in January this year; last year, 51,217 cases (nearly 2,000 confirmed) and 46 deaths were reported cumulatively.

gcT3PO7oNppJJ1WAInLzLA.zh: 古巴疫情更新,2025年累計報告51,217例病例(近2,000例確診)及46例死亡相關病例,該國15個省均報告病例,主要受影響地區包括馬坦薩斯省、哈瓦那省及卡馬圭省等省份。
gcT3PO7oNppJJ1WAInLzLA.en: Cuba update: in 2025, 51,217 cases were reported cumulatively, of which nearly 2,000 were confirmed, along with 46 associated deaths. All 15 provinces of the country reported cases. The main affected areas include Matanzas, Havana and Camagüey provinces.

t4ea5qR1YHO6SpbWcxk55Q.zh: 據報載,古巴傳出高燒、紅疹、脫皮、關節腫脹、嘔吐及腹瀉等症狀病例明顯增加,於2025年10月下旬1週內新增1萬餘例發燒病例,截至12月中旬報告52例死亡,專家分析可能有多種病毒流行,如登革熱、屈公病、奧羅普切熱、流感及新冠病毒等,造成診斷困難。
t4ea5qR1YHO6SpbWcxk55Q.en: According to media reports, Cuba has seen a marked increase in cases with high fever, rash, peeling skin, joint swelling, vomiting and diarrhoea. More than 10,000 fever cases were added within one week in late October 2025, and as of mid-December, 52 deaths had been reported. Experts analysed that multiple viruses may be circulating, including dengue, chikungunya, Oropouche fever, influenza and COVID-19, which makes diagnosis difficult.

TSo6J_MB_fUrSIW7HB10_g.zh: 古巴疫情更新,今年1-11月累計報告38,342例病例及21例相關死亡,該國14個省均受疫情影響,病例主要分布於馬坦薩斯省、哈瓦那省、卡馬圭省、西恩富戈斯省等省。
TSo6J_MB_fUrSIW7HB10_g.en: Cuba update: from January to November this year, 38,342 cases and 21 associated deaths were reported cumulatively. All 14 provinces are affected, and cases are mainly concentrated in Matanzas, Havana, Camagüey and Cienfuegos provinces.

VsMcbmIXpHnzUOzBM4qkdg.zh: 中國廣東省近期疫情上升,近1週(9/21-27)新增3,153例病例,較前1週2千餘例增加,主要分布於江門市2,927例,其次為佛山市78例,無報告重症及死亡病例,其中,江門市已連續2週於單週新增逾2千例,當地已啟動突發公共衛生事件三級響應,加強疫情防控。 古巴西部馬坦薩斯省報告確診病例,為該國自2015年以來首次報告病例,且各地報告之蟲媒疾病病例數均有增加,當地已加強病媒防治措施,另美國CDC提升古巴屈公病疫情旅遊警示至第2級。
VsMcbmIXpHnzUOzBM4qkdg.en: Guangdong Province, China: The outbreak has risen recently. In the past week (21–27 September), 3,153 new cases were reported, up from more than 2,000 the previous week. Most were in Jiangmen city (2,927), followed by Foshan (78). No severe or fatal cases were reported. Jiangmen has recorded more than 2,000 new cases in a single week for two consecutive weeks, and has launched a Level III public health emergency response to strengthen outbreak control. In Matanzas province in western Cuba, confirmed cases were reported, the country's first reported cases since 2015. Vector-borne disease cases have increased in various regions, and local authorities have strengthened vector control measures. In addition, the US CDC has raised its travel alert for chikungunya in Cuba to Level 2.

0xGF5Q0WNSrT3oR8zcJtBw.zh: 美洲地區今年截至7月累計11國報告逾12,700例確診病例,其中,巴西、哥倫比亞、古巴、巴拿馬、秘魯及委內瑞拉均有報告本土病例,以往疫情主要分布於亞馬遜雨林地區,惟近2年已傳播至原流行區以外地區。泛美衛生組織(PAHO)針對美洲局部地區屈公病疫情及奧羅普切熱病例持續發生,於8/29呼籲美洲地區加強監測及病媒控制,將奧羅普切熱感染納入疑登革熱感染之鑑別診斷中,並提醒可能出現之神經系統併發症狀。
0xGF5Q0WNSrT3oR8zcJtBw.en: In the Americas, as of July this year, 11 countries had cumulatively reported more than 12,700 confirmed cases. Locally acquired cases have been reported in Brazil, Colombia, Cuba, Panama, Peru and Venezuela. Previous outbreaks were mainly in the Amazon rainforest region, but in the past two years the disease has spread beyond its original endemic areas. In view of continued chikungunya outbreaks in parts of the Americas and continued Oropouche cases, PAHO on 29 August called on the region to strengthen surveillance and vector control, to include Oropouche infection in the differential diagnosis of suspected dengue, and to be alert to possible neurological complications.

zekEQCwJMOQXY8FKV6j3Lg.zh: 美洲疫情更新,今年截至第30週共11國累計報告12,786例確診病例,其中,巴西11,888例(5例死亡)、巴拿馬501例、秘魯330例、古巴28例、哥倫比亞26例、委內瑞拉5例、蓋亞那1例、烏拉圭3例(境外移入)、智利2例(境外移入)、美國及加拿大各1例(境外移入)。受到氣候變遷等因素導致病媒─帕拉庫蠓孳生,進而造成病毒傳播至非流行地區(如古巴市區)。此外,英國亦報告3例病例,均有巴西旅遊史。去年美洲地區累計報告16,239例確診病例(4例死亡),歐洲地區亦報告30例境外移入病例。
zekEQCwJMOQXY8FKV6j3Lg.en: Americas outbreak update: as of week 30 this year, 11 countries had cumulatively reported 12,786 confirmed cases: Brazil 11,888 (5 deaths), Panama 501, Peru 330, Cuba 28, Colombia 26, Venezuela 5, Guyana 1, Uruguay 3 (imported), Chile 2 (imported), and the USA and Canada 1 each (imported). Climate change and other factors have led to proliferation of the vector, the Culicoides paraensis midge, which has spread the virus to non-endemic areas such as central Havana, Cuba. In addition, the UK reported three cases, all with travel history to Brazil. Last year, the Americas cumulatively reported 16,239 confirmed cases (4 deaths), and Europe also reported 30 imported cases.

FAbqNgLPt-7DziaUW6B5qg.zh: WHO於6/10公布風險評估報告,主要病媒為帕拉森斯庫蠓(Culicoides paraensis),其廣泛分布於美洲,疫情主要發生於亞馬遜雨林地區,2024年病例數明顯上升且持續傳播至原流行區以外地區,並首次於古巴發生疫情,且美國及歐洲部分國家亦報告境外移入病例,另巴西報告多起垂直傳染致新生兒小頭症等不良妊娠案例。人類病例主要透過病媒叮咬感染,目前尚未報告人際傳播病例,惟近期發生疑垂直感染案例,持續對其傳播機制進行研究。WHO評估於主要病媒活躍地區風險為中,存在次要病媒地區風險為低,主要病媒已知不存在地區風險為非常低。
FAbqNgLPt-7DziaUW6B5qg.en: WHO published a risk assessment on 10 June. The main vector is Culicoides paraensis, which is widely distributed in the Americas. Outbreaks have occurred mainly in the Amazon rainforest region. Case numbers rose markedly in 2024, and transmission has spread beyond the original endemic areas. An outbreak has occurred in Cuba for the first time, and some countries in the United States and Europe have reported imported cases. Brazil has reported several cases of vertical transmission leading to adverse pregnancy outcomes, including microcephaly in newborns. Human cases are mainly infected through vector bites, and no person-to-person transmission has been reported so far; recent suspected vertical transmission cases are being studied to clarify the transmission mechanism. WHO assesses the risk as moderate in areas where the main vector is active, low in areas with secondary vectors, and very low in areas where the main vector is known to be absent.

ITI4PYY-v0aUhf7jeYgIVg.zh: 古巴疫情更新,該國迄今累計報告23,639例病例,626例確診病例,其中76例為林-巴利症候群(Guillain-Barré syndrome),近50%病例有胃腸症狀,病例分布於該國各省,惟自2024年底迄今尚無報告確診病例。
ITI4PYY-v0aUhf7jeYgIVg.en: Cuba update: the country has reported 23,639 cases cumulatively, of which 626 were confirmed. Of these, 76 were Guillain-Barré syndrome. Nearly 50% of cases had gastrointestinal symptoms. Cases were distributed across the provinces of the country, but no confirmed cases have been reported since late 2024.

aYTVFezm8Q1htlvpY4IQ4A.zh: 美國佛州疫情更新,於12月第1週新增4例本土病例,今年迄今累計74例,主要分布於邁阿密-戴德郡,以第3型血清型為多;該國今年迄今累計90例本土病例。 古巴疫情正於13個省份迅速蔓延,大量患者住院治療,其中,已發現6例重症病例,同時,奧羅普切熱亦在該國15個省份流行,大多數病例皆居家治療,惟登革熱和奧羅普切熱的臨床表現非常相,致民眾誤解其感染之疾病,而衍生重症。
aYTVFezm8Q1htlvpY4IQ4A.en: Florida State, United States: In the first week of December, four new local cases were reported, bringing the cumulative total for 2024 to 74, mainly in Miami-Dade County, predominantly serotype 3. The country has reported 90 local cases cumulatively in 2024. Cuba: The outbreak is spreading rapidly across 13 provinces, with many patients hospitalised, and six severe cases have been identified. Oropouche fever is also circulating in 15 provinces of the country. Most of these cases are treated at home. However, the clinical presentations of dengue and Oropouche fever are very similar, which leads people to misidentify their infection and can result in severe illness.

5Le7wF2JlCuYzShdrD6Bzg.zh: 美洲疫情更新,今年截至11/25累計11,634例病例,其中2例死亡均來自巴西,共11國/地區報告病例,分別為巴西(9,563)、秘魯(936)、古巴(603)、玻利維亞(356)、哥倫比亞(74)、厄瓜多(2)、蓋亞那(2)及巴拿馬(1)。另美國(94)、加拿大(2)及英屬開曼群島(1)亦報告病例,皆為境外移入病例;此外,巴西已報告垂直感染確診病例。WHO評估該病毒對區域的公共衛生風險為高,對全球的風險為低。
5Le7wF2JlCuYzShdrD6Bzg.en: Americas update: As of 25 November this year, 11,634 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 2 deaths, both from Brazil. A total of 11 countries/territories have reported cases: Brazil (9,563), Peru (936), Cuba (603), Bolivia (356), Colombia (74), Ecuador (2), Guyana (2) and Panama (1). The United States (94), Canada (2) and the British overseas territory of the Cayman Islands (1) have also reported cases, all of them imported. In addition, Brazil has reported confirmed cases of vertical transmission. WHO assesses the public health risk of the virus as high for the region and low for the world.

KGsMtpD5lCJcXtlohtztbw.zh: 美洲疫情更新,今年1-9月累計1萬餘例病例,其中2例死亡均來自巴西,共9國報告病例,分別為巴西(8,258)、秘魯(936)、古巴(555)、玻利維亞(356)、哥倫比亞(74)、厄瓜多(2)及蓋亞那(2),另美國(90)及加拿大(2)亦報告病例,皆為境外移入病例。
KGsMtpD5lCJcXtlohtztbw.en: Americas update: From January to September this year, more than 10,000 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 2 deaths, both in Brazil. A total of 9 countries reported cases: Brazil (8,258), Peru (936), Cuba (555), Bolivia (356), Colombia (74), Ecuador (2) and Guyana (2). The United States (90) and Canada (2) also reported cases, all of them imported.
